note: Small primitive campground near Pingree Park along the South Fork Cache la Poudre in lodgepole pine, elev ~9,000 ft; reached via well-maintained gravel Pingree Park Rd (CR 63E), passable by passenger cars. --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP current-conditions status table: confirmed 10 sites (page; table says 12), FCFS, vault toilets, no water, $19. flags: CRITERIA (length, AWH to decide): the forest's Canyon Lakes campground status table (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions) lists 'Tom Bennett | 12 | 20' | First-come, first-served | $19 | May 15 - Nov 15' (Max Spur 20'). The FS campground page says 'This is an older facility and will not accommodate larger RVs.' and 'RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur because driving or parking off road is not permitted. The parking length ranges from 15 to 25 feet.' Not every agency figure is under 23 ft (the page's range tops out at 25), so recorded 25, but the forest's own maximum is 20 ft and EKKO is 23 ft: at best one or two spurs would fit, unconfirmed. recreation.gov's informational listing (10076130) repeats 'will not accommodate larger RVs' and gives no lengths.

Phone: none stored. The FS page lists only the forest's Fort Collins number 970-295-6600 (Supervisor's Office, which the brief gives for the Canyon Lakes RD); no separate district number on the page. Suggest 970-295-6600.
Website: stored https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/10076130 is an informational listing (not reservable, no booking); the FS page is the useful one.
Count: FS page 'There are ten sites' (recreation.gov the same); the forest's status table says 12. Kept 10.

Road: CR 63E (Pingree Park Road) 'OPEN' in the ARP road status table (updated 10/14/2026; 'A Larimer County Level 5 Road'). The Cameron Peak Fire road closure order 02-10-05-26-01 (April 16 - Nov 30, 2026) closes NFS roads 129, 129.A/B, 177, 177.B/C, 154.C, 344 (part), 152.1/152.2, 345.B (part) - not CR 63E or the campground. FS directions: Hwy 14 26 mi, 'Turn left (south) on County Road 63E. Drive approximately 17 miles to the campground.' No RV/4WD wording on the road.

Pin 40.57555,-105.58396 sits on the campground loop road; the FS coordinates (40.57557,-105.58516) are ~100 m west at the west end of the loop, recreation.gov's (40.574373,-105.582368) on the access road ~190 m SE. OK.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: NHD puts the South Fork Cache la Poudre ~40 m from the pin, but on NAIP it is invisible under continuous lodgepole canopy and is creek-sized at this altitude; no open apron or sightline can be shown from any site. Default down holds.
